```artifact
Feature: Alarms GUI Control

  Scenario Outline: Set HIGH RR alarm threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to <value>
    Then the threshold should be set to <value>

    Examples:
      | value |
      | 5     |
      | 10    |
      | 20    |
      | 30    |
      | 5     |
      | 30    |
      | 31    |

  Scenario Outline: Set LOW RR alarm threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to <value>
    Then the threshold should be set to <value>

    Examples:
      | value |
      | 5     |
      | 10    |
      | 20    |
      | 30    |
      | 5     |
      | 30    |
      | 31    |

  Scenario Outline: Set apnea alarm threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to <value>
    Then the threshold should be set to <value>

    Examples:
      | value |
      | 1     |
      | 10    |
      | 20    |
      | 30    |
      | 1     |
      | 30    |
      | 31    |

  Scenario: Relief valve opens alarm
    Given the GUI is open
    When the relief valve opens
    Then an alarm should be triggered
```
